title-group.article-title: Synthetic MD protocol article for software regression testing

sec.title: Molecular dynamics methods
sec.p: The initial coordinates were taken from PDB ID 1UBQ, corresponding to UniProt accession P0CG47.
Simulations were performed with GROMACS 2022.3 using the CHARMM36m force field and TIP3P water at 310 K and 1 bar in the NPT ensemble.
A time step of 2 fs was used. Three independent replicas were generated, with each production simulation for 500 ns.
